Notes — design.md

Wisp一设计笔记

常驻后台的工具首先要安静：空闲时几乎不占CPU，不弹无关的通知，也不抢走你正在使用的应用的焦

点。Wisp stays out of your way: it idles at near-zero CPU, wakes in milliseconds, and streams the

translation right next to your cursor.
